items.title: AAOI vs. Lumentum: Which Optical Networking Stock Has an Edge Now?
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics benefits from strong AI-driven transceiver demand, but LITE has an edge with superior stock performance, improving profitability, and rising earnings estimates.

items.title: Lumentum (LITE) Stock Looks Richly Priced As Its Three Year Run Continues
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings has delivered a very strong multi year share price run, capped by sharp swings this year, which naturally raises a question for anyone looking at the stock today. Is the current valuation that traders are paying really supported by its sales, especially after recent news driven moves? Over the past 3 years the share price has risen by a very large amount of about 12x, which puts a lot of weight on whether the revenue base can justify where the stock now trades. Recent...

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Climbs 5% on $2.2 Billion Hyperscaler Supply Deal; Lumentum and Coherent Drop 6%
items.summary: While AI stocks sell off, one small optical player is rallying on a massive four-year contract from a mystery buyer. But a thin profit, heavy dilution, and a stalled factory expansion raise a harder question about whether it can deliver.

items.title: Wall Street May Not Be Ready for What’s Coming Next for This Little-Known AI Stock
items.summary: A small optics maker just beat earnings estimates, landed a huge AI supply deal, and watched its stock crater anyway. The market now values it at less than its bank balance, and the reason may be hiding in the production calendar.

items.title: Why Is Marvell Technology Stock Falling 5% Today?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) shares fell 5% in premarket trading on Tuesday, reversing part of Monday’s gain of more than 18% as semiconductor stocks retreated and Susquehanna lowered its price target for the company. Concerns surrounding the valuation of Marvell’s proposed acquisition of Lumentum, potential shareholder dilution and broader market weakness also weighed on investor sentiment.

items.title: Wall Street’s New M&A Mood: Why Both Marvell-Lumentum and CrowdStrike-Zscaler Hit Pushback
items.summary: Two blockbuster AI-era deals landed on strong earnings, yet shareholders balked at both. One buyer got punished far harder than the other, and the reason says a lot about how investors now price consolidation.
